items.title: Sensex Today | Stock Market Live: Sensex jumps over 350 pts, Nifty above 23,450; metals surge over 2%, PSU banks, realty rise over 1% | Moneycontrol News
items.summary: Sensex Today | Stock Market Live: Indian stock market benchmarks traded higher on Wednesday afternoon, with the Sensex up over 350 points at near 74,900, and Nifty at 23,450. Metals led sectoral gains, surging over 2 percent, while PSU banks, realty and FMCG rose more than 1 percent each.
